name: Akeno Observatory
notes: After AGASA ended in January 2004 the observatory continues as an inter-university facility for tests of new detectors (ICRR page); no further experiment is recorded here.

operator.quote: Institute for Cosmic Ray Research The University of Tokyo
operator.value: Institute for Cosmic Ray Research, University of Tokyo

summary.plain: A University of Tokyo cosmic-ray station in the Yamanashi mountains, home of the Akeno air-shower arrays and of AGASA, once the world's largest air-shower array.
summary.technical: ICRR observatory (established April 1977) at 900 m in Hokuto, Yamanashi; hosted the 1 km2 Akeno array (completed 1979) and AGASA (100 km2, 1990-January 2004); today used for development and testing of high-energy cosmic-ray and gamma-ray instruments.
